chunks: And Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Abi Jarir al-Qummi, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام: "Should I marry my brother from my mother to my sister from my father?" So Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام said: "Marry her to him, or marry him to her."

key_terms.أُزَوِّجُ: I give in marriage; I arrange a marriage contract

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Islamic law to marry a maternal half-brother to a paternal half-sister?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the permissibility of marrying a maternal half-brother to a paternal half-sister. The Imam عليه السلام affirms that such a marriage is permissible, since the two do not share both parents and are not among the prohibited degrees of marriage.
